description_en: Modifies the intra-group connectivity policy of a basic security group
description_zh: 本接口用于修改一个普通安全组的组内连通策略
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-security-group-policy --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --inner-access-policy Drop --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySecurityGroupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the security group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 安全组所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The internal connectivity policy between ECS instances in the security group. Valid values:

Accept: intra-group connectivity
Drop: internal isolation

The value is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh:
安全组内的ECS实例之间的内网连通策略。取值范围：

Accept：互通。
Drop：隔离。

取值不区分大小写
parameters.name: inner_access_policy

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
